summary: Disciplinary dismissal vs MACT award; suppression of material evidence; review allowed based on contrary stand in MACT proceedings; Labour Court finding set aside; back wages awarded; no remand deemed necessary; fraud on court alleged; proportionality and perversity examined; finality of departmental inquiry challenged.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
Associate Builders v. Delhi Development Authority, 2015 (3) SCC 49
T.N. State Transport Corpn. (Coimbatore) Ltd. v. M. Chandrasekaran, (2016) 16 SCC 16
Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation, Jaipur v. Phool Chand
Deepali Gundu Surwase v. Kranti Junior Adhyapak Mahavidyala, (2018) 18 SCC 229
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned order upholding review petition upheld; dismissal set aside; back wages and benefits from termination to superannuation confirmed; no reinstatement due to superannuation.
